title: Strength Plus Memory Foam Coir Orthopedic Mattress With Euro Top
description: Sleep like never before with Strength Plus - an advanced support Euro top orthopedic mattress recommended and tested by doctors at National Health Academy. Designed with high density coir for firm support and natural coolness, this orthopedic mattress offers 5 Zoned support based on the preferred needs of each zone of your body. Cased in a rich knitted fabric, it comes with a special Euro top finish that offers advanced pressure relief and enhanced plushness for greater comfort and support.
